title: Tube Bender Capacity Chart: Published Limits for 9 Benders
excerpt: A tube bender capacity chart built only from maker-published specs: OD, wall and 4130 limits for 9 benders, one source per row, with conflicts flagged.

asins.product: Woodward Fab WFB2 manual tube & pipe bender

sources: ASME B36.10 pipe tables (NPS 1-1/2 = 1.900 in OD, NPS 1-1/4 = 1.660 in OD), per WRITER-KIT fact table
notes: Reference table uses only maker-published numbers (plus the Amazon listing for the Eastwood OD conflict). Research was via web-search result summaries; maker sites could not be opened directly from this environment, so please spot-check key cells. Conflicts flagged: Rogue M605 wall .188 (catalogue/comparison table) vs .250 DOM (FAQ); Eastwood HC OD 1-2 in (Eastwood) vs 3/4 in (one Amazon bullet); JD2 manual limit (JD2) vs KMS Tools retail copy. Baileigh RDB-050 die wall figures (.095/.109/.120) are presented as the wall each set's CLR is 'based on', not as max-wall limits. JD2 manual example pressures (900/1,400/3,100 psi) came from a search summary of the M32 manual: please verify. Rogue chart: 1.25x4.5 max wall and 1.5/1.75 die aluminium/stainless minimums were not visible, so cells say 'Check with maker'. Pro-Tools square tube range (1/2-1-1/2 in) and JD2 manual square/solid limits come from the fact-check notes (Part 3.6).
